# Subway Seat for television

The fzf port's colors for tv: gold matches, a raised row for the selection, quiet counts and borders, and the mode badge in burnt orange. File previews come from bat, so the bat port colors those. tv falls back to its default theme without a word if a theme file doesn't parse.

[television](https://github.com/alexpasmantier/television) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/television/) · Needs television 0.10+

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat.toml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the [ui] table of ~/.config/television/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the [ui] table of ~/.config/television/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in the [ui] table of ~/.config/television/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/television/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
